name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering with Language Features
definition: Extends the standard 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterizer to simultaneously render a language feature image alongside the RGB image by passing precomputed per-Gaussian language features to the rasterization backend.
summary: This method extends 3D Gaussian Splatting to simultaneously render language feature images alongside RGB by adding a parallel feature channel and normalizing features per Gaussian to prevent magnitude bias.
